runtime_pipeline.meaning: Accept the request without becoming execution authority.
Resolve canonical workspace, session/task, mode, permission and persisted state.
Provide bounded project context, registered capabilities and evidence expectations without granting authority.
Interpret the objective, investigate, choose exposed capabilities and propose actions.
ALLOW, DENY or explicit high-risk authority decision before execution.
Execute only through the governed adapter boundary.
Record operation identity, result and evidence of what actually happened.
Continue reasoning over receipts/evidence without gaining execution authority.
Decide completion from evidence; provider prose is not terminal truth.
Project persisted truth without becoming a second runtime.

document_authority.rule: One fact has one live owner. Historical acceptance evidence must not remain discoverable as competing current authority.
